text: The Climate and Disaster Resilient Small-Scale Water Resources Management Project (CDRSSWRMP) in Bangladesh aims to modernize small-scale water resources to enhance climate and disaster resilience in rural agriculture and fisheries. The project, led by the Local Government Engineering Department (LGED), is co-financed by the Asian Development Bank (ADB), the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD), and the Government of the Netherlands. It focuses on infrastructure rehabilitation, community-based water governance, and agribusiness interventions to improve productivity and incomes in climate-vulnerable areas.
